baseline_models.mechanism: The opening posture and the recalled summons form a bodily reversal. Humble lowering is already occurring in the eyes, and the prostration root independently carries a branch of steady lowered gaze; humiliation now forces an ocular analogue of the prostration that could formerly have been offered by the whole person.

activation_trace.role: Low humble submission includes lowered gaze and bodily bowing, joining the first clause to the requested posture.
Literal eyesight locates the compelled lowering in the organ that had been able to look.
Overwhelming coverage makes abasement the force imposing the present posture.
Abasement under overpowering distinguishes this lowering from freely chosen humility.
Steady lowered gaze and languid eyes supply the exact ocular form into which prostration is displaced.

changed_reading.before: Their eyes are downcast from shame after a missed summons to prostrate.
changed_reading.after: The missed prostration returns as an involuntary prostration of the eyes: the posture is achieved under humiliation rather than offered freely.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus roots preserve two non-equivalent ways of becoming low. One is gentle, voluntary yielding without disgrace; the other is abasement imposed by an overpowering burden. Former soundness made the first mode possible, while the present engulfing converts the same broad posture into the second.

activation_trace.role: Gentle yielding without humiliation supplies the voluntary mode that remained available earlier.
Abasement under overpowering supplies the coercive mode now covering them.
Coercive burdening provides the pressure that changes yielding into imposed humiliation.
Prostration spans humble lowering and voluntary or compelled submission, holding both modes in one bodily action.
Soundness and freedom from defect mark the earlier condition in which yielding need not have been forced.

changed_reading.before: They once could prostrate, but now they are humiliated.
changed_reading.after: The ayah contrasts voluntary yielding while intact with yielding extracted by overpowering pressure: a similar low posture carries opposite agency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ترهقهم ... وقد كانوا يدعون ... وهم سالمون
baseline_models.mechanism: Nearing, catching up, and pressure at an appointed time combine with explicit past predication. The verse can therefore be heard as a closed interval: call and capacity once coincided, then abasement caught up after that usable interval had passed.

activation_trace.role: Nearing and catching up turns humiliation into an arriving consequence rather than a static attribute.
Pressed time near an appointed rite supplies the sense of an opportunity reaching its limit.
Past temporal predication establishes the former state as a bounded condition.
A voiced summons supplies the opportunity that was present during the earlier interval.
Soundness supplies the capacity that once overlapped with the summons.

changed_reading.before: The past clause simply contrasts an earlier healthy state with present shame.
changed_reading.after: The clause records an expired affordance: humiliation catches them only after the finite window in which summons and capacity coincided.

baseline_models.mechanism: The sight root includes inner discernment, proof, and self-witness. With the eyes grammatically possessed by those whom humiliation overtakes, their lowered sight can register not only public shame but inward recognition that can no longer sustain a contrary account.

activation_trace.role: Inner sight, proof, and self-witness make the gaze an epistemic witness against its owner.
Lowered gaze gives inward recognition a visible bodily consequence.
Overwhelming coverage prevents the self-witness from remaining a detached perception.
Overpowered abasement turns recognition into a publicly legible verdict.

changed_reading.before: The lowered eyes merely display an emotion.
changed_reading.after: The eyes are also self-witnesses: inward recognition becomes bodily evidence that the owners cannot look past.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening pen and ordered writing, followed by the announced marking of a nose, make the face a surface on which judgment becomes readable. The focus then supplies eyes whose lowered posture and covering humiliation function like a completed public inscription rather than an inaccessible private feeling.

activation_trace.role: The sharpened writing implement supplies the instrument side of a legible-verdict mechanism.
An ordered written line supplies inscription as a durable public record.
The nose or snout locates the announced mark on the same face whose eyes later disclose humiliation.
The physical eyes provide the facial surface that makes the verdict visible.
Lowered gaze supplies the readable sign inscribed by posture rather than ink.

structural_cues: The branchless و س م occurrence at 68:16 word 1 supplies the act of marking only as a structural cue.
The sequence runs from pen and writing to a marked face and finally to eyes that visibly carry abasement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, a marking construction, the nose, and lowered eyes; I infer that facial posture becomes a readable verdict. A live alternative is a looser motif of public exposure without an inscription mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The eyes disclose an internal state of shame.
changed_reading.after: Their lowered eyes operate as the final line of a public verdict written onto the face by posture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early promise that both sides will see is followed by an assay-like dispute and by knowledge as disclosure. When the focus finally names their eyes, sight is no longer a neutral faculty: the promised adjudication has landed in the organ itself, whose posture reveals the result.

activation_trace.role: Mutual future seeing establishes sight as the medium of a deferred disclosure.
Testing metal or a person supplies an assay whose result can later become visible.
Disclosure to the knower makes the future seeing an adjudicatory unveiling rather than mere observation.
Inner sight and self-witness allow the disclosed result to be recognized by those whose eyes bear it.
The lowered gaze embodies the outcome of the promised seeing.

structural_cues: The future pair in 68:5 leaves seeing unresolved, while 68:43 assigns a determinate posture specifically to their eyes.
The intervening contrast between error and guidance gives the visual disclosure a discriminating function.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deferred mutual seeing, testing, disclosed knowledge, and the final eye posture; I infer that 68:43 is one embodied landing of that verdict. The promised seeing could also extend beyond this single scene.

changed_reading.after: The eyes also carry the deferred verdict announced by 'you will see and they will see': seeing has become self-disclosing evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden moves from expected fruitfulness to a cut-off, ruined condition that its owners see and name as deprivation. That material sequence activates the low desolate-ground branch of خ ش ع: in the focus, their eyes themselves can image the razed landscape of a capacity that has been lost.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and separation supply the garden's abrupt transition from available yield to severed outcome.
Seeing with eye and insight makes recognition of the altered landscape part of the mechanism.
Deprivation and failure to obtain the intended good name the result perceived in the ruined ground.
Low desolate or dormant ground transfers the garden's ruined material profile into the downcast eyes.
The eyes are both the earlier instrument of recognizing loss and the later surface that images it.

structural_cues: The garden sequence turns overnight from planned harvest to sight, disorientation, and the explicit correction 'rather, we are deprived.'
The focus likewise juxtaposes a former viable condition with a present lowered state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a materially ruined garden, its visual recognition, deprivation, and a focus branch of desolate ground; I map the garden's state onto the eyes as an image. The live alternative is that the two scenes share only moral reversal, not material imagery.

changed_reading.before: Downcast eyes express humiliation after capacity is lost.
changed_reading.after: The eyes become a miniature ruined landscape: what happened to the expected garden now happens visually to former soundness and standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden owners answer their own morning call, lower their voices, proceed with exclusionary intent, and regard themselves as able. The focus's 'they had been called ... while sound' is thereby morally specified: capacity was not absent but selectively mobilized for concealment and exclusion rather than for prostration.

activation_trace.role: Raised calling supplies a summons that the group does answer when it serves its own plan.
Lowered secret speech shows controlled bodily and vocal agency used to conceal the plan.
Directed intent supplies the chosen goal toward which their capacity is organized.
Effective capability makes the earlier agency operational rather than merely theoretical.
The focus summons provides the call that did not receive the response given to their own call.
Soundness supplies the intact capacity whose selective use is exposed by the garden sequence.
The later lowered gaze reverses the earlier deliberate lowering of voices.

structural_cues: At 68:24 the whispered plan explicitly bars a poor person from entering, so the mobilized capacity has an exclusionary object.
At 68:26 the same group can still see and speak when its plan collapses; the focus later recalls a different unanswered summons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a self-issued call, covert coordination, intent, capability, and the focus's earlier summons; I infer a typological contrast in how agency is spent. The garden owners and the focus pronoun need not be numerically identical for the mechanism to operate.

changed_reading.before: Former soundness marks a neutral window of ability that later expired.
changed_reading.after: Former soundness is charged evidence of selectively exercised agency: call, coordination, and movement worked for exclusion, but not for the summons to prostrate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby contrast between muslimin and criminals activates the handover branch of the same root as salimun, while the next scene couples prostration with lost ability. Former soundness can thus be carried as an unspent means for active surrender, not only as bodily health.

activation_trace.role: Handing over and consigning activates active surrender within the root shared by muslimin and focus salimun.
Humble prostration supplies the concrete act in which surrender would be embodied.
Ability and capacity, now negated, define what earlier soundness had made usable.
Soundness anchors the reading in the focus word's direct condition of intactness.
The same-root handover branch supplies a latent purpose for that intactness without replacing the word's direct sense.

structural_cues: The sequence places muslimin at 68:35, inability to prostrate at 68:42, and former salimun at 68:43.
The contrast depends on morphology as well as root recurrence: muslimin and salimun are related but not interchangeable forms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a same-root contrast, handover, prostration, and lost ability; I infer that soundness was a means available for surrender. The live alternative, and safer direct gloss, is simple physical or functional capability.

changed_reading.before: They were physically sound when summoned.
changed_reading.after: Their soundness was also an unused affordance for self-handover: intactness could have become willing submission before ability closed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Book, binding record, oath, judgment, questioning, and demanded guarantor form a chain of claim-testing. Against it, the focus call can activate the دعو branch of claiming a right, while inner sight supplies self-witness; the summons to prostrate becomes the act that exposes whether the asserted standing can be warranted.

activation_trace.role: A written fixing that imposes judgment supplies the binding record against which claims are tested.
The oath supplies a purported guarantee extending the claim into the judgment scene.
Judgment between parties gives the surrounding questions a forensic frame.
Questioning and demand initiate the explicit test of who can answer for the claim.
Suretyship or guarantee supplies the missing warrant the challengers are asked to produce.
Claiming a right or affiliation lets the focus summons function as a demand that tests asserted standing.
Inner sight, proof, and self-witness make the lowered eyes evidence within the claim-testing mechanism.
Public abasement supplies the enacted adverse result when no warrant can stand.

structural_cues: The repeated rhetorical questions from 68:36 through 68:41 demand a rule, book, oath, guarantor, or partners before the bodily test arrives.
The explicit horizon 'day of rising' at 68:39 links the claim-testing sequence to the scene immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies records, oaths, judgment, questioning, guarantee, and focus branches of claim and self-witness; I infer a juridical summons whose bodily response tests standing. The sequence may remain polemical rather than a formal courtroom procedure.

changed_reading.before: The call to prostrate is principally ritual and the eyes show shame.
changed_reading.after: The call is also a claim-testing summons: the failed bodily response and self-witnessing eyes publicly invalidate an asserted entitlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding scene removes a cover, exposes the leg or names acute readiness, repeats the summons to prostration, and negates ability. The focus then applies a new cover: humiliation overwhelms them while the eyes enact the lowered ocular branch of prostration. Disclosure is therefore an exchange of coverings and bodily agencies, not merely a revelation followed by emotion.

activation_trace.role: Removing a cover supplies the initial exposure that opens the judgment scene.
Uncovering the leg for severity or readiness localizes exposure in a body part poised for action.
The voiced summons is repeated almost verbatim by the focus's retrospective clause.
The prostration root's lowered-eye branch anticipates the exact posture named at the start of the focus.
Negated capacity closes the possibility of producing the demanded whole-body act.
Overwhelming coverage supplies the new cover of humiliation after concealment is removed.
The eyes become the body part that can still register the demanded lowering.
Overpowered abasement names the covering imposed after exposure.

structural_cues: 68:42 and 68:43 repeat يدعون إلى السجود, first with present inability and then with past soundness.
The sequence isolates leg, whole-body prostration, and eyes, distributing agency across body parts without changing the demanded act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies removal of cover, an exposed leg or severity idiom, repeated summons, inability, and engulfing abasement; I infer an exchange in which exposure is followed by a punitive cover. The leg phrase may remain idiomatic, but its readiness branch preserves the bodily contrast.

changed_reading.before: A hidden reality is revealed, they cannot prostrate, and then they feel shame.
changed_reading.after: Exposure strips one cover only for humiliation to become another; the incapable body fails while the eyes involuntarily complete the requested lowering.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stepwise taking, extended time, concealed strategy, and durable tensile strength activate the catching and pressed-time branches of ترهقهم. Present humiliation becomes the arrival of a process that advanced by degrees during the interval in which they still appeared sound.

activation_trace.role: Taking degree by degree supplies the incremental motion hidden before the focus outcome.
Temporal extension and respite supply the apparent interval of continued safety.
Concealed strategy supplies direction to the otherwise unnoticed delay.
Extended solidity supplies the process's durable capacity to reach its end.
Nearing and catching up render humiliation as the endpoint that finally reaches them.
Pressed time converts the earlier period of soundness into expiring respite.
Past predication marks soundness as a former phase within the longer process.

structural_cues: The future first-person sequence at 68:44-45 explicitly joins unnoticed location, gradual movement, respite, strategy, and firmness.
The focus's وقد كانوا looks backward from a completed reversal and is compatible with that delayed process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies steps, delay, strategy, durability, and focus branches of catching and time-pressure; I infer that these describe the latent approach to the focus condition. The verses after the focus may instead assure a broader process rather than narrate its chronology.

changed_reading.before: Humiliation arrives as a punctual judgment after a past opportunity.
changed_reading.after: Humiliation is the moment an already advancing, deliberately prolonged process catches up; apparent soundness belonged inside the delay.

context_deltas.mechanism: One figure calls while choked, and grace catches him before casting into exposed blame; in the focus, others had been called while sound, but humiliation catches them. The two call-and-catch chains cross: distress does not prevent responsive calling, and soundness does not guarantee responsive yielding.

activation_trace.role: Raised calling supplies a response issued from within constriction, reversing the focus's unanswered call during soundness.
Holding breath and silence supply the constrained condition from which the call nevertheless emerges.
Beneficent grace supplies the force that interrupts the movement toward exposed blame.
Catching up supplies a beneficent counterpart to humiliation's catching movement in the focus.
Casting away supplies the consequence that grace prevents before it becomes final.
Open uncovered space gives the threatened disgrace a spatial form of exposure.
Blame supplies the near outcome intercepted by grace and comparable to the focus's abasement.
The earlier summons while sound supplies the unanswered side of the crossed call pattern.
Humiliation's nearing and catching supplies the adverse catch not intercepted in the focus.
Soundness sharpens the asymmetry: favorable condition did not produce the response that constriction did elsewhere.

structural_cues: The conditional at 68:49 explicitly holds together an approaching rescue and a counterfactual sequence of casting, exposure, and blame.
The call from constriction at 68:48 follows the focus's recollection of a summons made during soundness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two calls, two catching roots, opposed conditions, and opposed outcomes; I infer a counterfactual mechanism in which grace can intercept disgrace. The figures remain distinct, so this is a relational contrast rather than identity or automatic soteriology.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives a closed sequence from missed opportunity to overtaking humiliation.
changed_reading.after: A neighboring counter-sequence remains visible: grace can catch before disgrace does, while calling under constriction exposes the squandered privilege of being called while sound.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later hostile gaze nearly dislodges another from his station after its owners hear the reminder. Set against the focus, visual agency reverses: eyes that function like a projectile or destabilizing surface become lowered organs whose own possessors are covered by abasement. Their covering of truth also reverses into being covered.

activation_trace.role: Near-performance holds the hostile visual act at the edge of taking effect.
Covering truth supplies the agents' active covering, later reversed by humiliation covering them.
Dislodging a thing from its station on an unstable surface gives the hostile gaze kinetic force.
Physical eyes are the apparent instrument aimed at destabilizing another.
Understanding and compliance, activated but not realized by hearing, connect the hostile response to the earlier unanswered summons.
A reminder that actively recalls supplies what the hearing should have converted into response.
The same visual organ is now possessed, lowered, and deprived of its former outward aggression.
Low humble gaze supplies the reversal of visual elevation and attack.
Overwhelming coverage reverses the agents' own covering of truth into a condition imposed on them.

structural_cues: Both scenes make eyes grammatically belong to the opposed collective, but one directs them outward and the other lowers them inward.
Because 68:51 follows the focus in packet order, the relation is thematic and reversible rather than assumed to be simple chronology.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near-action, dislodging, hostile eyes, hearing, reminder, and humbled eyes; I infer a reversal from weaponized sight to defeated sight and from covering to being covered. The same collective is strongly suggested by discourse but not proved by branch data alone.

changed_reading.before: Their eyes are passive indicators of humiliation.
changed_reading.after: The lowered eyes are the reversal of previously weaponized sight: the organ aimed at dislodging another can no longer maintain its own elevation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant mapped root د ع ع beneath the focus occurrence of د ع و, and its forceful-driving image must not replace the direct sense of a summons. It remains anchored to the exact focus root mapping and coheres with coercive burdening and compelled lowering; downstream prose should call it a kinetic undertone or branch activation, never a lexical translation.

activation_trace.role: The split-root branch of rough thrusting or forceful driving adds a latent shove beneath the ordinary voiced summons.
The cry telling a stumbler to rise adds an ironic upward command inside a scene whose demanded act is downward.
Coercive burdening keeps the forceful undertone functionally connected to the imposed present posture.
Compelled or voluntary lowering supplies the bodily destination toward which the latent drive points.

changed_reading.before: The call is purely invitational and coercion begins only with later humiliation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the summons carries a buried shove and a cry to rise, making force and bodily reversal audible inside the call itself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the snakebitten person called 'sound' is an ironic lexical branch, not the ordinary predication of سالمون. It remains anchored to that exact focus root and gains mechanism from gradual taking and respite; downstream prose should present it only as a diagnostic analogy for apparent intactness during latent injury, not as the verse's direct gloss.

activation_trace.role: The snakebitten person called sound supplies ironic intactness that may conceal an injury already received.
Catching up lets the concealed injury analogy mature into the later overtaking condition.
Degree-by-degree movement supplies the latent advance hidden beneath apparent soundness.
Extended respite supplies the interval in which hidden damage and a label of soundness can coexist.

changed_reading.before: Soundness is simply the absence of impairment at the time of the call.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, 'sound' can name apparent intactness while an unnoticed process is already advancing toward visible humiliation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates lexicalized prostration branches involving image-coins and tribute, then links them to the nearby burden of financial liability. The reading remains anchored to السجود and to the focus's coercive burden and abasement, but it is a political-economic analogy rather than a proposed ritual gloss; downstream prose should qualify it explicitly as branch-distant.

activation_trace.role: Image-coins before which submission is made supply a material sign of authority and compelled recognition.
Lexicalized tribute supplies an economic form of subordinating acknowledgment.
Coercive burdening connects ritual refusal to an exploratory model of imposed liability.
Abasement under power supplies the social relation enacted by forced tribute.
A binding financial liability activates the economic consequence side of the analogy.
The loading of a burden makes liability bodily oppressive rather than merely notional.

changed_reading.before: The missed prostration is exclusively a refused ritual posture.
changed_reading.after: Branch-distantly, refusal of willing acknowledgment can return as imposed tribute-like liability: submission is extracted as burden and public abasement.

strongest_changes: The requested whole-body prostration reappears involuntarily as prostration of the eyes under an engulfing cover of abasement.
The garden sequence specifies former soundness as capacity selectively spent on covert exclusion, not neutral ability left unused.
The adjacent scene exchanges coverings and body-part agency: concealment is removed, whole-body capacity fails, and the eyes perform the lowering.
Stepwise delay makes humiliation a process catching up, while the nearby grace narrative preserves an opposed catch that can intercept exposed blame.
The hostile gaze of 68:51 reverses into the humbled gaze of the focus, turning outward visual force into inward self-witness.
summary.what_was_special: The packet sustained several mechanisms at once: bodily displacement, temporal expiry, public inscription, material ruin, juridical testing, crossed call-and-catch sequences, and reversal of visual force. Split and lexicalized branches were retained only with explicit containment rather than flattened into direct glosses.
remaining_uncertainties: The garden owners and the collective in the focus support a strong typological echo, but the packet alone does not prove numerical identity.
The same-root movement from salimun to muslimin is morphologically suggestive but must not erase the distinct forms or the direct sense of soundness.
The relation between the focus and 68:51 is thematic and reversible; verse order does not by itself establish a simple earlier-to-later chronology.
Non-dominant and lexicalized branches can diagnose latent structure, but prose should keep them exploratory and avoid presenting them as translations.
